summary: A criterion that enumerates its own parts (FS-60: 32 design frames) can never pass incrementally, and nothing in the pipeline notices or tracks the fraction
evidence: lightning-lane unified-create-alert FS-60 folds 13 source acceptance criteria into one line over 32 frames; its 16:51 report shows 2 driven on current build, 26 stale, 3 absent, 1 unreachable, all one not_met. Addressed by AMEND-001 as a Parts column plus an alignment-artifact instruction in VCON-B007
